Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

  • Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.

  • Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.

Overview

We are looking for a Senior Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead the design and delivery of end-to-end ML/AI systems that turn vast volumes of claims, clinical, and member data into measurable performance and reduced waste. You will define technical strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and own systems that directly shape payment accuracy, risk adjustment, and quality outcomes for the payers we serve. This role sits at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, translating ambiguous, high-stakes problems into scalable, auditable ML solutions.

The ideal candidate has operated at large scope across multiple teams and product surfaces — not just shipped models, but defined the problem, built the evaluation infrastructure, created the data flywheel, and drove measurable business outcomes. They think in systems, write crisp design docs, bring intellectual honesty to experimentation, and treat auditability and precision as first-class requirements rather than afterthoughts. They raise the level of the engineers around them.

Responsibilities

  • Define system architecture for AI/LLM-powered products end to end over claims, medical records, and clinical documentation.
  • Build and own evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-Judge, offline metrics, online experiments) aligned to accuracy, auditability, and clinical and regulatory risk — because outputs inform payment and compliance decisions.
  • Drive the data flywheel: convert expert clinician and auditor review decisions into high-quality labeled data, and close the loop with fine-tuning of models to lift detection precision.
  • Explore building patient-level digital twins fromclinical charts for unified processing layer and data presentation across payment, risk and quality.
  • Lead ranking and prioritization systems that surface the highest-value claims, audits, and care gaps for human review, improving both reviewer efficiency and financial impact.
  • Establish reusable platform patterns — shared context stores, evaluation harnesses, feature pipelines — that compound value across product surfaces and lines of business.
  • Partner across engineering, product, clinical, and analytics teams to align on success criteria, roadmap priorities, and production rollout.
  • Mentor senior engineers and elevate organization-wide standards in ML craftsmanship, experimentation rigor, and system design.
  • Sets company-wide standards.
  • Acts as a thought leader beyond Cotiviti to elevate the reputation and visibility of Cotiviti in the industry.
  • Influences the enterprise AI/ML strategy at an executive level.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Required

  • PhD in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science/Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research covering Advanced Statistics, Machine learning and AI.
  • 12+ years of industry experience building production ML systems at scale.
  • Deep expertise in two or more of: LLM evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), ranking, or large-scale classification.
  • Proven track record leading end-to-end ML projects, from problem framing through production impact.
  • Strong experimentation discipline: A/B testing, causal inference, metric design, and opportunity mining.
  • Proficiency in Python (PyTorch), SQL at scale (Presto / Trino / Spark), and distributed pipeline tooling (Airflow).
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, product, and analytics.

Highly valued

  • Experience building LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation pipelines aligned to quality, risk, and accuracy criteria.
  • Hands-on supervised fine-tuning of embedding or reranking models with measurable production gains.
  • Experience with healthcare data (claims, electronic health records, or clinical coding such as ICD, CPT, or HCC).
  • Background designing ML systems in regulated, auditable, or high-stakes domains (healthcare, finance, or fraud, waste, and abuse detection).
  • Familiarity with building systems that handle sensitive data under frameworks such as HIPAA.
  • Background building canonical data services or platform-level ML infrastructure adopted organization-wide.
  • Applied mathematics, statistics, or quantitative PhD background.
  • LLM ecosystem: RAG pipelines, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, prompt engineering, supervised fine-tuning.

Cognitive/Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Problem-solving and thinking critically.
  • Completing tasks independently.
  • Interpreting data.
  • Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Pay Transparency:

Base compensation ranges from $250,000 to $280,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Date of posting: 7/6/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 10/6/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

Job Title: Talent Acquisition Business Partner
Reports to: Director of Talent Acquisition
Job Location: Remote in PA, NY, NJ
Salary Range: 70K - 80K (base + Commission)
FLSA Status: Exempt

Company Overview:

AIR Control Concepts is more than just a collection of firms, we are a community of forward-thinking experts committed to excellence, innovation, and collaboration. With a focus on commercial HVAC representation, we bring together esteemed entities from diverse regions, each boasting decades of invaluable experience.   
We understand that success in the HVAC industry goes beyond individual accomplishments. That's why we believe in the power of unity and collaboration. By leveraging our collective assets, knowledge, and resources, we empower our member firms to deliver unparalleled service, safety, and efficiency to clients across healthcare, commercial, and residential sectors.   

Check out our website here: AIR Control Concepts 

About the Role:

The Talent Acquisition Business Partner manages the full recruitment lifecycle while providing market intelligence, workforce insights, and consultative guidance to business leaders across the Northeast Region. This role will recruit for a broad range of positions including specialized HVAC Sales Engineers, Senior Sales Engineers, Commercial HVAC Service Technicians, Controls Technicians, Applications Engineers, Project Managers, Service Coordinators, Parts and Inside Sales professionals, Warehouse and Inventory personnel, Administrative support roles, and regional leadership positions. The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of the HVAC, building automation, service, applied equipment, controls, and mechanical services industries and can effectively identify and attract both active and passive talent within these highly competitive markets.


Key Responsibilities:
Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Manage the complete recruiting process from requisition launch to offer acceptance.
  • Conduct intake calls with hiring managers to gather role requirements, define qualifications, set expectations, and establish a hiring strategy.
  • Draft, post, and maintain accurate job descriptions and job ads across job boards and the ATS.
  • Screen and qualify candidates through resume review, phone screens, behavioral assessments, and skill evaluations.
  • Present qualified candidates to hiring managers with detailed summaries and recommendations.
  • Schedule interviews, facilitate debriefs, and guide hiring teams through selection decisions.
  • Partner with HR to ensure smooth offer, pre-employment, and onboarding processes.
Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Development
  • Utilize job boards including Indeed, ZipRecruiter, RecruitMilitary, LinkedIn and Handshake to proactively source talent.
  • Build and maintain pipelines for high-volume and hard-to-fill roles.
  • Leverage Boolean search, resume databases, social channels, and industry-specific platforms to identify passive candidates.
  • Conduct outreach campaigns to engage qualified talent and promote employer brand visibility.
  • Track, evaluate, and report on sourcing effectiveness and pipeline health.
Hiring Manager Partnership
  • Develop strong, consultative relationships with hiring managers across multiple departments and locations.
  • Provide insights on market trends, candidate availability, and competitive landscape.
  • Advise hiring managers on sourcing strategies, interview best practices, and selection methods.
  • Maintain regular communication and provide status updates on open roles and pipeline activity.
  • Ensure alignment on job requirements, candidate profiles, and hiring timelines.
Compliance & Process Excellence
  • Maintain accurate and organized candidate documentation and workflows in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Ensure adherence to all company policies, EEO guidelines, and recruiting compliance standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, TA efficiency, and candidate experience.
  • Participate in special projects, hiring initiatives, career fairs, and employer branding efforts as needed.

Experience and Requirements:
  • 1-3 years of full-cycle HVAC recruiting experience
  • Experience with sourcing through Indeed, ZipRecruiter, LinkedIn, RecruitMilitary, Handshake, and resume databases.
  • Strong interviewing skills with the ability to assess skills, experience, and cultural fit.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and consultative skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience using an ATS (JazzHR, Greenhouse, UKG Pro, or similar).
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize competing tasks.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Union recruiting experience preferred
  • Experience supporting multi-site or multi-state hiring needs.
  • Knowledge of Boolean search techniques and sourcing automation tools.
Benefits:
We offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including:
  • Health & Wellness – Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage to support your well-being.  
  • Financial Security – 401(k) retirement plan with company match and short/long-term disability coverage.  
  • Work-Life Balance – Paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, and an employee assistance program (EAP).  
  • Professional Development – Ongoing training opportunities and support for continuing education.

The Company provides equal employment opportunity in accordance with applicable laws and prohibits discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are based on business needs and qualifications.
The Company complies with disability laws and provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $25 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

raw.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

raw.description:
At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.

Position Description

Connect Centric is seeking a Workday Integration and Support Engineer to support and improve our client’s Workday Financials, HCM, Payroll, Planning, and related enterprise systems. You will partner with Finance, IT, HR, Payroll, vendors, and implementation partners to maintain reliable day-to-day operations, resolve production issues, support integrations and reporting, and deliver practical system improvements.

This role requires hands-on experience with Workday Studio and Workday Orchestrate, along with a strong understanding of Workday connectors, including Core Connectors. Experience with PECI and EIB is a plus.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot Workday integrations with internal and external systems, using Workday Studio and Workday Orchestrate as key development tools.
  • Support connector-based integrations, including Core Connectors, and troubleshoot issues involving data flows, configuration, and downstream systems.
  • Build and support integrations using RaaS, REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP, XML, XSLT, and XPath, with EIB, PECI, PICOF, and WECI used where applicable.
  • Improve integration reliability, scalability, monitoring, documentation, and support procedures.
  • Triage and resolve Workday incidents, service requests, integration failures, and data issues; conduct root-cause analysis, document resolutions, escalate when needed, and communicate status clearly.
  • Support ITIL/ITSM processes and identify opportunities to improve service quality and operational stability.
  • Support Workday migrations, testing, release validation, change control, and production deployments; coordinate releases and enhancements with stakeholders and change control teams.
  • Validate integration performance, data accuracy, report outputs, security access, and business process changes.
  • Create, maintain, and troubleshoot Workday reports, calculated fields, security configuration, and data extracts.
  • Support data mapping, transformation, conversion, reconciliation, validation, and issue resolution across Workday and downstream financial systems.
  • Partner with business, functional, and technical teams, vendors, and implementation partners to translate requirements into supportable solutions and deliver enhancements.
  • Maintain functional and technical documentation, support procedures, decision logs, and knowledge articles.

Required Qualifications

  • At least five years of experience supporting Workday in a production environment.
  • Hands-on experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting integrations using Workday Studio.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday Orchestrate to build and support integrations and orchestrated workflows.
  • Strong understanding of Workday connectors, including Core Connectors, their configuration, data flows, and role in integrations with external systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday reports, calculated fields, security, business processes, integrations, and data validation.
  • Familiarity with RaaS, REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP, XML, XSLT, and XPath.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, change control, and deployment support skills.
  • Experience with data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, validation, reporting, monitoring, and production support.
  • Experience with ITIL/ITSM support processes and the ability to communicate clearly with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate across business, technical, and vendor teams and manage multiple priorities in a business-critical support environment.
  • Attention to detail and a service-oriented approach, with a commitment to data accuracy, documentation, operational reliability, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with PECI integrations.
  • Experience building and supporting EIB integrations.
  • Workday production support experience across Financials, HCM, Payroll, or Planning.
  • Workday integration-related certification or ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Experience with Workday implementations, data conversion, post-go-live stabilization, or major enhancements.
  • Experience with MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, or similar integration platforms; PeopleSoft; Atlassian tools; and external implementation partners.

Position Details

  • Position Type: Full-time W-2 employment. Independent contractor or 1099 arrangements are not available for this position.
  • Location: Remote
  • Pay Rate: $115K - $125K

This is a remote position.

​

We are seeking an experienced and solutions-orientedInsureMO Platform Configuratorto lead the configuration, integration, and orchestration of insurance products and microservices powered by theInsureMO (eBaoTech)middleware platform.

In this role, you will be responsible for translating complex underwriting rules, product specifications, and policy administration lifecycles into InsureMO’s cloud-native digital insurance architecture. You will configure and maintain end-to-end insurance offerings across multiple core modules (Product Factory, Policy, Billing, Claims, and Partner/Channel Portals), working closely with underwriters, enterprise architects, and ecosystem integration partners.

Key Responsibilities

1. InsureMO Platform & Product Configuration

  • Configure, build, and deploy insurance products usingInsureMO Product Factory / Product Master, defining dynamic coverage structures, risk objects, clauses, limits, deductibles, and endorsement types.

  • Implement and fine-tune complex pricing formulas, rating tables, referral rules, and underwriting matrices directly within InsureMO’s rule and rating engines.

  • Configure end-to-end insurance lifecycles across core modules:

    • Policy Lifecycle:New Business, Quotation, Underwriting clearance, Bind, Issuance, Mid-Term Adjustments (Endorsements), Renewals, and Cancellations.

    • Billing & Collections:Premium invoicing, payment schedule definitions, reconciliation rules, refund management, and commission structures.

    • Claims Microservices:First Notice of Loss (FNOL), claim registration, reserve management, basic settlement flows, and rule-based claim triage.

  • Build dynamic, multi-channel customer and agent journeys via InsureMO’s workflow orchestration and portal configuration tools.

2. API Orchestration & Third-Party Integration

  • Leverage InsureMO’s extensive catalog of Open APIs/Microservices to orchestrate real-time data flows between InsureMO and upstream digital channels (Mobile Apps, Web Portals, Aggregators/Brokers).

  • Integrate InsureMO microservices with downstream enterprise systems (Core PAS, General Ledger/ERP, Document Management, Payment Gateways, and third-party data enrichers).

  • Configure payload mappings, data transformations, webhook triggers, and event-driven services using JSON/XML.

3. Insurance Domain & Business Analysis

  • Partner closely with Business Analysts, Underwriting SMEs, and Product Managers to break down complex policy guidelines and rate filings into clear technical configuration specifications.

  • Validate that configured product behaviors comply with regional regulatory standards and insurance filing requirements.

4. Testing, Defect Resolution & Deployment

  • Execute unit testing, scenario-based rating validation, and system integration testing (SIT) to ensure mathematical precision in premium calculations and policy rules.

  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders, triage configuration defects, and manage versioning across development, staging, and production environments.

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for product models, mapping sheets, API contracts, and configuration runbooks.


Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • InsureMO Hands-on Experience:Direct, hands-on experience configuring and implementing insurance products and workflows on theInsureMO (eBaoTech)platform.

  • Module Expertise:Proven implementation exposure across multiple InsureMO modules/APIs, includingProduct Factory, Policy, Billing, and Claims.

  • Insurance Domain Knowledge:Strong understanding of insurance operations and the policy administration lifecycle (P&C / General Insurance, Life, or Specialty lines).

  • Technical & Integration Competencies:

    • Proficient with RESTful APIs, Swagger/Postman, Webhooks, JSON, and XML payload structures.

    • Solid understanding of microservices architecture, API gateways, and cloud-native digital insurance ecosystems.

    • Basic proficiency in SQL (relational database querying) and scripting/logical expressions.

  • Delivery Frameworks:Hands-on experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments utilizing tools like Jira, Confluence, and Git.

  • Education:Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Exposure to embedded insurance, affinity partnerships, or aggregator/broker portal integrations via InsureMO.

  • Prior experience with other modern or legacy core PAS platforms (e.g., Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or eBaoTech GeneralSystem).

  • InsureMO certification or recognized insurance domain certifications (e.g., INS, AINS, CPCU, or LOMA).


Benefits

Benefits
At Exavalu, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications for employment from all qualified candidates, regardless of race, color, gender, national or ethnic origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other status protected by applicable law. We nurture a culture that embraces all individuals and promotes diverse perspectives, where you can make an impact and grow your career. Exavalu also promotes flexibility depending on the needs of employees, customers and the business. It might be part-time work, working outside normal 9-5 business hours or working remotely.. We also have a welcome back program to help people get back to mainstream after a long break due to health or family reasons.

About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

The Principal Electrical Engineer, typically reporting to the Electrical Engineering Director, assumes a pivotal leadership role within the Electrical Engineering department. With the potential to lead project-specific teams and play a crucial role in achieving project objectives, this role leads project-specific engineering and design tasks, ensuring strict adherence to project goals and requirements. Highly skilled in project engineering and design work, the Principal Electrical Engineer handles complex and high-impact assignments, providing technical expertise to guide project success. The role involves extensive collaboration, with responsibilities including overseeing multiple engineering teams, coordinating complex projects, and actively participating in strategic planning initiatives. Enjoying substantial freedom to act, the Principal Electrical Engineer leads project teams and influences decision-making within the department, contributing to the overall success and direction of engineering projects. Examples of tasks include leading the design and implementation of innovative electrical systems, coordinating efforts across project teams, and contributing to the development of strategic initiatives within the department. This role represents a significant opportunity for leadership and impact within the field of electrical engineering.

Position Overview

Vantage is looking for a Principal Electrical Engineer to be part of the design engineering team, steering innovative design and engineering solution for our data center projects. In this role, as a subject matter expert, you will be focusing on program improvement initiatives as well as supporting the deployment of new data center from land acquisition to Operation hand-off. These functions collaborate closely with construction, automation, innovation, and engineering to fully deliver large-scale data centers. As an engineering leader, you will also work closely with other company stakeholders, such as sales, equipment procurement, new site development, and leadership.

You will be presented with complex engineering challenges and will work with teams to bring them to resolution. You will ensure engineering standards are developed, executed, and enhanced for projects. You will evaluate design to meet customer requirements while providing a balance of CAPEX and OPEX costs, engineering innovation, and site application requirements. There will also be some focus on special projects that support data center renovations, troubleshooting, and remediation activities. These projects tend to be more focused in scope and typically require detailed attention since they can involve a live facility.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead design initiatives that align with the company's strategic direction and goals.

  • Drive the development and implementation of processes, equipment, and standards for data center projects.

  • Lead Electrical Design review efforts for deployment of new Data Centers, ensuring compliance with corporate standards and customer requirements.

  • Participate in all phases of project execution, including conceptual design, basis of design, scope of work, development of construction documents, and commissioning.

  • Provide project leadership for electrical design consultants and contractors, ensuring that tasks and milestones are completed on time and within budget.

  • Attend project design team meetings and on-site job walks, as needed, to ensure that the constructed product meets engineering standards and specifications.

  • Conduct value engineering analyses and provide system recommendations based on return on investment (ROI) and internal rate of return (IRR) analysis.

  • Responsible for the review of technical drawings, such as schematic drawings, design and construction documents, main submittals, sequence of operations, commissioning scripts

  • Support Site Operations by troubleshooting and tuning existing systems to optimize performance.

  • Coordinate heavily with internal engineering teams across all disciplines to ensure products delivered to Operations are streamlined and optimized to meet the needs of the business across all functions.

  • Work closely with Operations to balance cost-effective solutions with long-term operational sustainability.

  • Provide technical support to Sales during site tours, RFP responses, and customer Build To Suit (BTS) Data Center solutions.

  • Participate in product development process flow from idea to implementing the company’s Intellectual Property (IP) initiatives.

  • Engage in continuous professional development through training, participation in professional societies, associations, and continuing education.

  • Assist the Electrical Tech Lead and management in mentoring, developing and coaching junior engineers.

  • Review engineering studies, including:

    • Short-circuit and over-current protection device coordination studies.

    • Arc Flash mitigation studies.

    • Rack layout optimization, including fail over analysis.

    • Distribution analysis, including voltage drop and underground duct bank heat effect (Neher-McGrath) calculations

    • Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) calculations

    • Additional duties as assigned by Management

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, or equivalent, from an accredited university or college

  • Professional Engineering license in any state within the United States.

  • 10 years of experience in design and construction is required, and 15+ years is preferred.

  • Working knowledge of critical electrical and cooling infrastructure within a data center is required.

  • Data Center design and/or construction experience is required.

  • Familiarity with building codes, regulations, and standards, such as NEC, NERC, IEEE, NFPA and local building codes.

  • Experience with NA construction markets is required.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to conduct feasibility studies and technical analyses.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, project teams, and stakeholders.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office. Understanding of AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, Navisworks and SCCS modeling software environments

  • Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Problem-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

  • High level of integrity and professionalism.

  • Travel required is expected to be up to 25% but may increase over time as the business evolves.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage Data Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Vantage Data Centers does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage Data Centers.

raw.description:
Job Type:Full-Time

Schedule:Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Pacific Time

Compensation:$20–$24/hour DOE

Position Overview

Burnett Therapeutic Services (BTS) is seeking an experienced, highly organized Payroll Specialist to take primary ownership of payroll administration, payroll compliance, final paychecks, timekeeping, and related HR operations.

This position serves as the primary point of accountability for ensuring payroll is accurate, timely, and compliant with applicable federal and state requirements, with particular emphasis on California payroll and wage-and-hour requirements.

The Payroll Specialist will also coordinate the day-to-day workflow of HR Assistants, delegating administrative HR and payroll tasks, monitoring deadlines, reviewing work for accuracy and completion, and ensuring employee changes are processed correctly and on time.

The ideal candidate has hands-on payroll experience, strong knowledge of California payroll requirements, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage a high-volume workflow while guiding HR support staff.

Payroll Administration & Compliance

  • Take primary ownership of the payroll process and ensure payroll is completed accurately and on schedule.

  • Review payroll and timekeeping records for accuracy, completeness, and timely processing.

  • Verify employee hours, pay rates, compensation changes, bonuses, reimbursements, deductions, sick time, PTO, and other payroll-related entries.

  • Enter and verify staff hours in NPA based on finalized Appointment Admin records.

  • Send and manage payroll-close communications, including Lock NPA and Super Locker processes.

  • Review drive time, overtime, meal and rest break issues, and other timekeeping discrepancies and ensure necessary corrections are completed before payroll closes.

  • Process and reconcile sick time and PTO entries with approved records.

  • Maintain accurate employee payroll information in ADP and oversee payroll setup for new employees.

  • Review payroll reports and identify discrepancies before payroll is finalized.

  • Research and resolve employee payroll questions and discrepancies promptly.

  • Maintain appropriate payroll documentation and records.

  • Support payroll audits, reconciliations, reporting, and compliance reviews.

  • Stay current on applicable payroll and wage-and-hour requirements and escalate complex compliance matters to leadership or legal counsel when appropriate.

Final Paychecks & Employee Separations

  • Take ownership of the final-pay process for resignations, terminations, and other employee separations.

  • Determine applicable final-pay deadlines based on the circumstances of the separation and applicable state requirements.

  • Calculate final wages, including regular hours, overtime, applicable premiums, reimbursements, and other amounts due.

  • Determine whether accrued vacation/PTO or other balances must be included in final wages based on company policy and applicable law.

  • Coordinate with HR and management to ensure separation information is received early enough to meet final-pay deadlines.

  • Verify final paycheck calculations before payment is issued.

  • Maintain documentation supporting final-pay calculations and payment.

  • Coordinate separation letters, payroll changes, benefit notifications, and other required offboarding steps.

HR Assistant Workflow & Team Coordination

  • Coordinate and oversee the daily workflow of HR Assistants.

  • Assign and prioritize HR and payroll administrative tasks based on deadlines and operational needs.

  • Maintain clear workflow trackers so responsibilities, deadlines, and outstanding items are visible.

  • Review work completed by HR Assistants for accuracy and completeness.

  • Ensure new hires, employee changes, leaves, resignations, terminations, payroll updates, and other personnel transactions are processed timely.

  • Train and guide HR Assistants on established HR and payroll procedures.

  • Serve as the escalation point when HR Assistants encounter payroll, timekeeping, employee-record, or procedural questions.

  • Identify workflow problems and implement processes, checklists, and controls to prevent missed deadlines or incomplete work.

HR Operations

  • Serve as a resource for employees and managers regarding payroll, timekeeping, benefits, and HR procedures.

  • Ensure required employee and payroll information is entered accurately and timely.

  • Coordinate resignations, terminations, and leaves of absence with HR Assistants and management.

  • Maintain confidential employee records and consistent documentation.

  • Prepare and submit required EDD forms and other employment-related notices accurately and timely.

  • Coordinate employee leave documentation, notices, tracking, and return-to-work processes.

  • Support benefits enrollment, changes, reminders, and employee communications, including EASE health plans.

  • Assist leadership with employee documentation and other HR operational matters as assigned.

  • Recognize matters requiring management, HR leadership, or legal review and escalate appropriately.

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Maintain payroll and HR trackers, reports, calendars, and data logs.

  • Establish recurring payroll and HR deadlines and ensure responsible team members complete assigned tasks.

  • Identify payroll discrepancies, recurring errors, missed deadlines, and opportunities for process improvement.

  • Develop and maintain payroll and HR procedures, checklists, and internal controls.

  • Prepare payroll and HR reports for leadership as requested.

  • Help ensure continuity of payroll and HR operations through clear documentation and cross-training.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Minimum of 3 years of payroll, HR/payroll, or closely related experience.

  • Direct hands-on payroll processing experience required.

  • Experience supporting California employees and working with California payroll and wage-and-hour requirements strongly preferred.

  • Experience calculating and coordinating final paychecks and employee separations.

  • Working knowledge of overtime, timekeeping, payroll deductions, paid leave, reimbursements, and payroll recordkeeping.

  • Experience with ADP or a comparable payroll system required; ADP experience strongly preferred.

  • Experience coordinating or reviewing the work of HR or payroll support staff preferred.

  • Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to independently manage deadlines and identify payroll issues before payroll is finalized.

  • Strong judgment and ability to recognize when an issue requires management or legal review.

  • Excellent customer service and professional communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel, including trackers, reports, and payroll-related data.

  • High standards of confidentiality, accountability, accuracy, and professionalism.

  • Experience with NPA and EASE preferred.

Key Accountability

The Payroll Specialist is ultimately responsible for ensuring that payroll-related information is accurate, complete, compliant, and processed on time. HR Assistants may perform administrative steps within the payroll and HR workflow, but the Payroll Specialist is responsible for overseeing the process, verifying completion, identifying discrepancies, and escalating issues when necessary.

Why Choose BTS?

At BTS, you’ll find a long-term career with mentorship, training, and growth opportunities. We collaborate with compassion and respect individuality, fostering an environment where everyone can thrive and grow.

Pay & Benefits

  • 6 paid holidays after one year of employment

  • Accrued sick time

  • Shadowing opportunities and hands-on mentorship

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for eligible employees working 30+ hours per week

  • 401(k) retirement plan for eligible employees who have accrued 1,000 hours of service within 12 months

  • Aflac supplemental insurance options for eligible employees

  • LifeCare Employee Assistance Program

  • LifeMart Employee Discount Program

  • Access to tuition discounts and scholarships with partner universities

About BTS

BTS is a leader in behavioral and mental health care and a pillar in the communities we serve. We are a privately owned agency founded in 2015 by a BCBA and a Marriage and Family Therapist. We serve children and families throughout California, offering behavior therapy, family support, and skill-building programs.

Do you remember the teacher who went above and beyond to help you realize your potential? At Vanguard College Prep, we are looking for educators ready to pay that forward.   • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

What You Will do:

  • Teach and Inspire: Instruct small groups of students in their English core skills to promote long-term understanding of topics and top scores in their college readiness exams (ACT & SAT).
  • Track Growth: Track your students’ progress as they move through Vanguard’s unique multi-phase curriculum, engaging students in individualized growth and improvement opportunities along the way.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a humanities field from US Schools (English, Creative Writing, Journalism, Publishing, etc.) (Master’s or higher preferred)
  • Teaching experience in English and/or experience working in a college-level Writing Center (1+ years)
  • Demonstrated academic excellence (e.g., 3.5+ GPA).
  • Strong verbal skills and mastery of the English language
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, and G-Suites
  • Access to a reliable internet connection and a workspace with minimal noise/distraction
  • Commitment to work during Hours of Operations:
    • Mondays and Fridays: Closed
    • Tuesdays to Thursdays: 1:30 pm CST to 9:30 pm CST
    • Saturdays and Sundays: 9:30 am CST to 5:30 pm CST

The ideal candidate will also possess:

  • Experience teaching at the college or community college level
  • Robust understanding of classroom pedagogy and the ability to create customized, engaging lesson plans that use practical, real-world examples to inspire a love for learning
  • Desire to help students recognize, reach for, and realize their fullest potential
  • A dynamic and outgoing personality
  • The ability to work both independently and in a team environment

Why you want to teach with Vanguard College Prep:

  • Paid training and comprehensive preparation
  • Distinctive and individualized approach to test prep with a strong track record of producing top-tier students and nationally-ranked test scores
  • Opportunity to work with our distinctly engaged, enthusiastic, and driven client base of students energized by Vanguard’s commitment to the highest-quality client experience
  • Elite team of instructors, counselors, and specialists from top universities across the nation who are passionate about fostering student success
  • Quickly-growing start-up environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and leadership, with opportunities for long-term career growth

About Vanguard College Prep:

​​Vanguard College Prep is a full-service educational company whose mission is to enable the future leaders of our globalized world to meet their fullest potential. Through its test prep, college counseling, and college essay services, Vanguard is committed to providing meaningful, all-encompassing college preparation that treats each student as an individual, preparing them for the boardroom, not the assembly line.

Two things set Vanguard apart from other after school companies: our elite team and our personalized, organic curriculum. Unlike other test prep companies, which often take a one-size-fits-all approach to test prep, Vanguard recognizes that every student learns differently. Our experienced instructors and counselors strive to shatter this assembly line model by focusing on core learning rather than short-term strategies and tips, tailoring instruction to fit each student’s individual needs. We encourage students’ continual questioning and curiosity with the goal of extending learning beyond the classroom, so that our students will be successful in the elite college of their choice and beyond.

This role reports into the Sales VP.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

We’re looking for a Growth, Sales-Focused Account Manager to support new-business development and the growth and retention of existing insurance-sector clients. Approximately 60% of the role will focus on prospecting and securing new-logo opportunities, with the remaining 40% focused on developing and applying complex account-management skills.

At TransUnion you will be joining a friendly, forward thinking global business. As well as an excellent salary and bonus scheme or commission scheme (if joining our sales teams) our benefits package comes with:

  • Global paid wellness days off and a bonus day off to celebrate your birthday
  • A generous contributory pension scheme and access to the TransUnion Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Private health care and a variety of physical, mental and financial fitness wellbeing programmes such as access to mindfulness tools
  • Access to our diversity forums and communities so you can get involved in causes close to your heart

We are open to exploring training and development opportunities for the right candidate to ensure you are successful. We recognise that our people need the freedom to balance their day-to-day lives with their work. This is why we’ve set out to create inclusive and flexible policies and practices for you to accommodate all your responsibilities and needs: children, family and beyond. Job Title: Customer Experience Data Analyst

Reports to: Director, Customer Experience

Location: Remote CA/CO/AZ/TX


The Role

As a Customer Experience Data Analyst, you’ll empower Customer Experience leaders and teams to make informed decisions by translating orderbook and operational data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and clear business recommendations. You’ll develop and maintain Tableau and advanced Excel solutions, monitor data quality, and investigate discrepancies across reporting layers and source systems. You’ll own new projects and reporting initiatives end-to-end, collaborating with CE Leadership, Supply Chain, D&D, and global stakeholders. You’ll also apply approved AI and automation capabilities to improve the speed, quality, consistency, and scalability of reporting while maintaining data stewardship.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.


Your Impact


  • Build, maintain, and enhance Tableau dashboards and advanced Excel reporting solutions
  • Partner with Customer Experience and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven insights and recommendations
  • Design and validate reporting logic, calculations, and visualizations to ensure data accuracy and usability
  • Monitor reporting performance and investigate data discrepancies to support timely issue resolution
  • Support reporting migrations, enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Manage reporting requests, priorities, and stakeholder communication
  • Maintain reporting documentation, training materials, and governance standards
  • Deliver ad hoc analysis and reporting to support Customer Experience and Supply Chain business priorities

Who You Are


  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Excel with large datasets
  • 2+ years of reporting, analytics, or business intelligence experience
  • Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or similar BI tools
  • Advanced Excel skills including lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and large dataset analysis
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills
  • Ability to translate business objectives into reporting solutions and actionable insights
  • Experience with data quality validation and reporting governance practices
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote environment
  • Commitment to Deckers values: Be Bold, Honest, Open, Courageous, and Kind

What We'll Give You –


  • Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
  • Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
  • Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
  • Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.
$61,800.00 - $71,000.00

US - CO Remote Denver

Individual pay will be determined by location and additional factors, including job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Diversity and inclusion are key to our success. raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.


Part-Time, Vineland, NJ


Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.


Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).


Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.


Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (aligned with prospect time zones and outreach cadences)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Outbound Outreach Specialist to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold outreach, and relationship-building.

Prior HVAC industry experience is required, as this role involves engaging HVAC contractors, distributors, service providers, and industry decision-makers through targeted outbound outreach and lead generation efforts.

This is a performance-driven role focused on identifying potential customers, starting conversations, qualifying opportunities, and booking meetings for the sales team.

You’ll be responsible for building outbound campaigns across email, cold calls, LinkedIn, and multi-channel outreach while working closely with sales and marketing teams to drive qualified pipeline growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys outbound sales, understands B2B prospecting, and thrives in fast-paced, target-driven environments.

What You’ll Do:

Prospecting & Lead Research:

  • Research companies, decision-makers, and target accounts using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase, or similar platforms
    • Build targeted prospect lists aligned with Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs)
    • Identify pain points, industry trends, and personalization opportunities before outreach
    • Maintain organized lead lists and outbound workflows

Outbound Outreach & Lead Generation:

  • Execute outbound outreach across email, cold calling, LinkedIn, and other channels
    • Conduct 60–100 daily outbound touchpoints across multiple channels
    • Make 30–40 cold calls per day using structured outreach and objection-handling frameworks
    • Personalize outreach messaging based on prospect industry, role, and business needs
    • Build and maintain outbound cadences and follow-up sequences
    • Generate qualified conversations and book meetings for Account Executives or leadership

Campaign Management & Optimization:

  • Build and test multi-touch outbound campaigns and sequences
    • A/B test subject lines, CTAs, messaging angles, and call scripts
    • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize outreach strategies
    • Improve reply rates, booked meetings, and conversion performance through testing and iteration

CRM & Pipeline Management:

  • Maintain accurate CRM records in Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar systems
    • Log activities, conversations, notes, and pipeline updates consistently
    • Keep lead stages, statuses, and follow-ups organized and updated
    • Ensure strong CRM hygiene and organized pipeline tracking

Collaboration & Communication:

  • Work closely with Account Executives and sales leadership on qualified handoffs
    • Collaborate with marketing teams on messaging feedback and lead quality
    • Share insights from prospect conversations to improve outreach performance and positioning
    • Support broader outbound growth initiatives as needed

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Highly motivated by targets, goals, and measurable performance
    • Strong communicator across phone, email, and LinkedIn outreach
    • Resilient and comfortable handling rejection consistently
    • Organized and process-oriented with strong follow-through
    • Curious and proactive in researching prospects and industries
    • Competitive, coachable, and focused on continuous improvement

Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–2 years of SDR, BDR, outbound sales, or lead generation experience
    • Previous experience in the HVAC industry is required
    • Strong understanding of HVAC services, contractors, distributors, manufacturers, or related markets
    • Experience using outbound tools such as Outreach.io, SalesLoft, Apollo, or HubSpot Sequences
    • Experience making cold calls and running outbound outreach campaigns
    • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho
    • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
    • Ability to personalize messaging and conduct professional prospect outreach
    • Reliable internet connection and professional remote work setup

What a Typical Day Looks Like:

A Sales Development Representative’s day revolves around generating pipeline through proactive outbound outreach. You will:

  • Research target accounts and build prospect lists
    • Launch outbound email and LinkedIn sequences
    • Make cold calls and conduct follow-up outreach
    • Personalize messaging based on prospect pain points and industry
    • Book qualified meetings and hand off opportunities to the sales team

• Update CRM records and pipeline stages

  • Analyze outreach performance and optimize messaging
    • Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to improve conversion performance

In short: you are responsible for filling the pipeline with qualified opportunities through consistent outbound execution.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

• 60–100 outbound touchpoints daily

  • 15–20 meaningful prospect conversations weekly

• Qualified meetings booked monthly

• Outbound reply and conversion rates

  • CRM accuracy and pipeline organization
    • Consistent outbound activity and follow-through

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Practical Task (Outbound Messaging or Email Sequence Exercise)
    • Client Interview

• Offer & Background Verification
