raw.description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

Os times de infraestrutura são responsáveis por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa, da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem empregados pelos diferentes times técnicos até a definição e implantação de processos relacionados com a segurança da informação na empresa como um todo.

Requirements

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Arquitetura de Observabilidade: Projetar, implantar e manter a infraestrutura de telemetria (OpenTelemetry Collectors, agentes de métricas/logs/traces, concentradores e ferramentas de visualização), garantindo alta disponibilidade da própria plataforma de observabilidade.
  • Governança de Alertas e Métricas: Configurar o ecossistema de observabilidade para coletar dados de aplicações e infraestrutura, definindo regras de alerta acionáveis (Alertmanager/Incident.io) e reduzindo o ruído operando no modelo Observability-as-a-Service para os times de desenvolvimento.
  • Arquitetura e Nuvem: Projetar, operar e evoluir a infraestrutura em AWS utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Gestão de Kubernetes: Administrar clusters em produção, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e controle de custos.
  • CI/CD e Automação: Construir e otimizar pipelines de entrega contínua rápidas e confiáveis, eliminando trabalho operacional repetitivo (toil).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Guiar o time de infraestrutura/plataforma, organizar o backlog, distribuir tarefas e atuar como mentor(a) para os demais engenheiros.
  • Ponte com Produto: Negociar prioridades técnicas com os times de desenvolvimento e produto.

Habilidades necessárias

  • Cloud: Experiência profunda com provedores de nuvem pública (preferencialmente AWS).
  • Containers: Domínio avançado de Kubernetes e ecossistema de containers (Docker/containerd).
  • Vivência madura na operação e sustentação de sistemas distribuídos e de alta disponibilidade em produção.
  • Infraestrutura de Observabilidade (Hands-on): Experiência comprovada implantando e configurando a pilha de observabilidade via código (IaC/Helm). É necessário dominar o deploy e gerenciamento de ferramentas como Prometheus Operator, OpenTelemetry Collector, Grafana Stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir) ou agentes/arquitetura em soluções proprietárias (Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace), incluindo gestão de retenção e custo de dados de telemetria.
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis na nuvem.
  • Visão sistêmica de ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) para melhorar a experiência dos desenvolvedores (DevEx).
  • Visão de Engenharia de Telemetria: Entendimento profundo de como os dados de observabilidade são gerados, coletados, processados e armazenados (não apenas criar dashboards, mas entender o caminho que o log, a métrica e o trace percorrem desde a aplicação até o banco de dados de telemetria).
  • Experiência em protocolos de resposta a incidentes.
  • Experiência ou forte aptidão para facilitação de ritos ágeis e gestão de entregas de um pequeno time técnico.
  • IaC: Proficiência em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Pulumi ou similar).
  • Programação/Scripting: Capacidade real de codificar para automação (Python, Go ou Bash avançado).
  • CI/CD: Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Comunicação e Negociação: Saber traduzir dívidas técnicas e riscos de infraestrutura para uma linguagem de negócios, conseguindo negociar espaço no backlog com os demais times internos.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Resiliência e frieza para tomar decisões rápidas sob pressão durante incidentes (quedas de produção).
  • Perfil Mentoria (Servant Leadership): Gostar de ensinar, destravar o time e formar novos talentos, não apenas querer brilhar sozinho no código.
  • Pragmatismo: Saber equilibrar a "arquitetura perfeita" com as necessidades reais e o tempo de entrega que o negócio exige.
  • Requisitos diferenciais:
      • GitOps & Service Mesh: Prática com Argo CD, Flux, Istio ou Linkerd.
      • FinOps: Experiência prática na redução e otimização de custos de infraestrutura em nuvem.
      • Observabilidade Avançada e eBPF: Uso de eBPF (Cilium, Pixie) para observabilidade sem instrumentação pesada no código.
      • Otimização de Custos em Observabilidade: Estratégias de amostragem (sampling) de traces, agregação/descarte de logs em nível de coletor para evitar explosão de custos de ingestão na nuvem ou SaaS.
      • Segurança (DevSecOps): Gestão de segredos, políticas como código (ex: OPA/Gatekeeper) e segurança de supply chain.
      • Certificações: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), AWS Solutions Architect ou equivalentes.
      • Idiomas: Inglês técnico avançado (para leitura, conversação e condução de fóruns com eventuais fornecedores/times globais).

Benefits

O que oferecemos

    • Trabalho 100% remoto (trabalhe de onde quiser);
    • Escritório em RJ e SP com ambiente de trabalho descontraído (para quem quiser utilizar);
    • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento;
    • Flexibilidade de horários (sim, mesmo em home office);
    • Férias flexíveis (além do regime CLT);
    • Plano de saúde e dental Bradesco;
    • Seguro de vida em grupo;
    • Benefício Refeição via cartão Caju;
    • Auxílio mensal ao home office (móveis e internet);
    • Vale Home Office;
    • OrienteMe (apoio psicológico);
    • Conexa Saúde (apoio psicológico e nutricional);
    • Wellhub;
    • Day Off para aniversários;
    • Licença Maternidade de 6 meses;
    • Licença Paternidade de 1 mês;
    • Auxílio-creche;
    • Convênio SESC;
    • Game night (presencial no escritório do RJ e online no Discord);
    • BDC Learning e BDC Decola (programa de desenvolvimento e crescimento dos nossos profissionais através do subsídio de treinamentos diversos, como cursos, palestras, livros e outros);
    • Equipe unida e sempre pronta para apoiar.

raw.description:
Cardinal Health – Sonexus Health Pharmacy Services is seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer to join our AI & Innovation team. This role will focus on designing and delivering scalable, production‑ready AI solutions for healthcare and life sciences, with a strong emphasis on Agentic AI, agent orchestration, and Large Language Models (LLMs).


The ideal candidate will help advance Sonexus’ mission of improving patient access, affordability, and therapy outcomes by embedding responsible, secure, and compliant AI capabilities into enterprise healthcare workflows.


Position Overview


As an AI Engineer, you will be responsible for building, deploying, and scaling GenAI‑powered applications that support healthcare operations, patient services, and internal clinical‑adjacent workflows. You will work closely with product, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are reliable, compliant, and aligned with healthcare regulations and enterprise standards.

Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype, and deploy Generative AI applications using techniques such as Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, fine‑tuning, and vector search
  • Build and maintain Python‑based APIs and software components to support AI services and ensure scalable, production‑grade solutions
  • Develop multi‑step, agentic workflows for reasoning, task execution, and orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex
  • Integrate AI capabilities into healthcare and pharmacy services workflows, including case management, program operations, analytics, and internal knowledge systems
  • Deploy, monitor, and optimize GenAI models and pipelines using cloud‑native tooling, orchestration frameworks, and MLOps best practices
  • Contribute to the AI platform and reference architecture across cloud environments, including Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure AI solutions meet security, privacy, and compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA, PHI handling, responsible AI principles)
  • Document designs, patterns, and best practices to support enterprise reuse and long‑term platform sustainability
  • Evaluate vendor solution architecture, APIs, data flows, identity and access controls, security, scalability, interoperability, and operational supportability
  • Participate in technical discovery and proof-of-concept activities, document findings and trade-offs, and provide recommendations for vendor selection, integration approach, and implementation readiness.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field preferred
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python and any of the one programming language such as Java / .Net /C# etc preferred
  • 2+ years of hands‑on experience building GenAI / LLM‑based applications in real‑world or enterprise environments
  • Experience designing and implementing agentic or multi‑step AI workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or similar
  • Strong understanding of retrieval pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and LLM APIs
  • Experience deploying AI solutions in cloud environments (Azure and/or GCP)
  • Familiarity with secure application development and enterprise integration patterns
  • Experience working in healthcare, life sciences, pharmacy services, or regulated industries preferred
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, PHI data handling, and secure AI design in compliance‑driven environments preferred
  • Exposure to responsible AI practices, model monitoring, and governance in enterprise settings preferred
  • Experience supporting internal business users such as care teams, case managers, analytics teams, or program operations preferred

Anticipated salary range: $96,300 - $151,360

Bonus eligible: No

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan

  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 12/05/2026 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

Job Title: Avantra AdministratorJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Local* * *

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an experienced Avantra Administrator to help elevate our enterprise SAP operations through intelligent monitoring, automation, and system management. In this role, you will ensure the Avantra platform operates securely, efficiently, and reliably across a complex business and technology landscape. You’ll collaborate with SAP Basis teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure engineers, application owners, and business stakeholders to drive operational excellence and strengthen system visibility, automation, and resilience.

Responsibilities:

As an Avantra Administrator, you will:

  • Administer and maintain the Avantra platform, including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and environment support across all landscapes.
  • Manage user provisioning, authentication, permissions, and access controls in alignment with organizational security policies.
  • Configure and support SAP monitoring—including system health, performance checks, background job monitoring, alerting, and automation policies.
  • Monitor Avantra system performance, availability, logs, alerts, and automation jobs; troubleshoot failures and coordinate timely resolution.
  • Maintain connectors, service accounts, agents, credentials, and secure access mechanisms across SAP and non‑SAP landscapes.
  • Develop and enforce governance standards for monitoring templates, alert thresholds, naming conventions, documentation, credential handling, and version control.
  • Partner with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to meet audit, backup, recovery, compliance, and continuity requirements.
  • Support migration of monitoring and automation configurations between development, test, and production environments.
  • Create and maintain operational procedures, runbooks, support guides, and technical documentation.
  • Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for Avantra-related incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
  • Support license administration and usage tracking for Avantra platform components.
  • Collaborate with SAP Basis, infrastructure, and application teams to troubleshoot monitoring gaps, alerting issues, performance concerns, and platform execution problems.
  • Recommend platform improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, automation maturity, and operational visibility.
  • Participate in release planning, testing, and change management processes.
  • Support audit, reporting, and governance requirements for SAP monitoring and automated operational workflows.
  • Provide end‑user and administrator training on dashboards, alerting, reporting, scheduling, and best practices.
  • Work within Agile delivery teams, contributing to backlog refinement, sprint planning, testing, and platform enhancement initiatives.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Active U.S. DoD Secret Clearance.
  • Ability to meet DoD 8140 requirements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise monitoring platforms, SAP operations, or business systems administration.
  • Experience administering Avantra or a comparable enterprise SAP monitoring/automation platform.
  • Strong understanding of:

    • Server configuration and maintenance

    • User/security administration

    • Monitoring, scheduling, and alert management
    • Troubleshooting performance issues, job failures, and alerting gaps

  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
  • Experience integrating enterprise monitoring tools with SAP and related operational support systems.
  • Familiarity with authentication and identity technologies (Okta, Active Directory, SSO, etc.).
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non‑technical teams.
  • Experience supporting SAP landscapes with SAP Basis, infrastructure, and application teams.

Desired:

  • Experience in DoD, federal, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with SAP operations, including SAP S/4HANA monitoring and administration.
  • Experience supporting enterprise platforms in finance, logistics, transportation, supply chain, or ERP domains.
  • Experience working with cloud-hosted or hybrid enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Splunk, and other ticketing/monitoring tools.
  • Exposure to Agile delivery frameworks (e.g., SAFe).
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Basis, system monitoring, or infrastructure automation.
  • Avantra training or certification.


-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
At Summit, every technology decision starts with the right partnership. Whether we're investing in infrastructure, expanding our capabilities, or supporting customer growth, strong vendor relationships help us deliver exceptional outcomes.

As the Director, Procurement & Vendor Management, you'll lead Summit's procurement strategy while building trusted partnerships with the technology vendors and suppliers that keep our business moving. You'll balance commercial strategy with operational needs - negotiating enterprise agreements, optimizing spend, improving supplier performance, and ensuring our teams have what they need to deliver for our customers.

This is more than purchasing. It's about building partnerships, making smart investments, and helping Summit scale with confidence.

What You’ll Do:
  • Develop and execute Summit's procurement and vendor management strategy, ensuring purchasing decisions align with business priorities and long-term growth.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with technology vendors, OEMs, distributors, and service providers.
  • Lead negotiations for hardware, software, cloud services, maintenance agreements, and professional services, securing favorable commercial terms while managing business risk.
  • Partner with Finance, Delivery, Sales, and executive leadership to support technology investments and operational initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize spend, consolidate vendors, improve contract terms, and maximize the value of Summit's technology investments.
  • Establish vendor performance expectations and develop meaningful metrics to evaluate supplier quality, responsiveness, and business value.
  • Oversee the contract lifecycle, including renewals, pricing reviews, vendor performance, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Establish and continuously improve procurement policies, standards, and governance that balance speed, financial stewardship, compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Analyze purchasing trends, contract commitments, and supplier performance to provide actionable recommendations to business leaders.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and direction for the Procurement team, fostering a culture of partnership, accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional internal service.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, supplier capabilities, and market trends to help inform procurement strategies and business decisions.
What You’ll Deliver:
  • Strategic supplier partnerships that support Summit's long-term business objectives.
  • Competitive commercial agreements that balance cost, quality, service, and risk.
  • Procurement processes that are efficient, scalable, and easy for internal teams to navigate.
  • Greater visibility into organizational spend, contract renewals, supplier performance, and sourcing opportunities.
  • Strong supplier accountability through measurable performance expectations and ongoing relationship management.
  • Trusted partnership with business leaders that enables informed purchasing decisions and supports operational success.
  • A procurement function that enables the business to move quickly while maintaining strong financial stewardship and vendor governance.
What You’ll Decide:
  • Procurement strategies for technology products, services, and strategic sourcing initiatives.
  • Vendor selection and sourcing recommendations for significant technology investments.
  • Negotiation strategies and commercial recommendations for enterprise agreements.
  • Procurement policies, standards, and governance practices.
  • Supplier performance expectations and vendor improvement plans.
  • Prioritization of procurement initiatives, team workload, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Development priorities and performance expectations for members of the Procurement team.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If You:
  • Have experience leading procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management within a technology, managed services, cloud, or enterprise IT environment.
  • Enjoy building long-term relationships and negotiating outcomes that create value for both the business and our partners.
  • Understand enterprise technology purchasing, including hardware, software licensing, cloud services, and professional services.
  • Can balance strategic planning with operational realities and step in when business priorities require it.
  • Build credibility across technical, operational, financial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Use data to support recommendations, evaluate supplier performance, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Communicate with confidence, navigate competing priorities, and bring people together to solve complex business challenges.
  • Believe great procurement enables the business; it doesn't slow it down.
Bonus Points:
  • Experience negotiating Microsoft licensing, CSP, Azure, or other enterprise technology agreements.
  • Experience managing relationships with strategic technology vendors such as Microsoft, Cisco, Dell, Equinix, Digital Realty, HPE, or similar partners.
  • Experience supporting contract lifecycle management, procurement systems, or ERP platforms.
  • Experience negotiating enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, or managed services agreements.
  • Familiarity with managed services, cloud infrastructure, or data center environments.
  • Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPSD, PMP, or similar.
How We Work at Summit

How you approach the work matters just as much as what you do. At Summit, our core values show up in how we make decisions, work together, and support our customers.

We build the infrastructure that keeps businesses running. We need people who take that seriously, and have fun doing it.

Our Core Values:

  • Empower our people
  • Constant elevation
  • Customer first
  • Focus on outcomes
  • Embrace curiosity
Benefits

Summit offers a total rewards package designed to support you at work, at home, and everywhere in between. Here’s a snapshot of what that looks like:

  • Flexible Time Off (yes, really) – take what you need, we trust you to manage it
  • Medical, Dental & Vision – comprehensive coverage with HSA/HRA options
  • 401(k) with 4% match – we invest alongside you
  • Parental Leave – paid time for the moments that matter most
  • Life & Disability Insurance – built-in peace of mind
  • Wellness Support – resources for your mental and physical health
  • Free Colocation & Cloud Access – build and experiment in real environments
  • Work From Anywhere – remote-friendly by design
  • A low-ego, get-it-done culture – come as you are, do great work
Compensation

The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $186,000 annually. Compensation is based on the responsibilities of the role, experience, skills, geographic market, and internal equity. We believe great careers are built one step at a time, and compensation should grow alongside your impact.

For internal candidates: We know your journey at Summit didn't start with this opportunity. When determining compensation, we'll also consider your contributions, demonstrated performance, and career progression - because the impact you've already made matters, too.

Summit is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Summit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

As part of this commitment, Summit will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please email .

raw.description:
Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Customer Stories Lead

Location

United States (Remote)

About Siemens Digital Industries Software

Siemens Digital Industries Software helps organizations of all sizes digitally transform using software, hardware, and services from the Siemens Xcelerator business platform. Our software enables companies to optimize their design, engineering, and manufacturing processes to turn today's ideas into the sustainable products of the future.

Position Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Customer Stories Lead to execute a customer storytelling and advocacy strategy developed in partnership with the Head of Customer Marketing. This role will own the day-to-day operation and activation of a high-impact customer stories program, transforming customer successes into compelling narratives that strengthen the Siemens brand, accelerate sales, support product marketing, and cultivate customer advocates.

Working closely with Growth leadership, the Customer Stories Lead will translate strategic priorities into a scalable customer proof engine that highlights measurable business outcomes and showcases the value of our solutions. The ideal candidate is an exceptional storyteller with strong customer empathy, commercial acumen, and the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value for enterprise audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Execute the Customer Storytelling Strategy

  • Partner with the Head of Customer Marketing to operationalize the customer storytelling, advocacy, and reference strategy.
  • Own the end-to-end customer story pipeline, including customer identification, qualification, outreach, interviews, content development, approvals, publication, and activation.
  • Develop customer-friendly processes for participation, permissions, approvals, advocacy tracking, and ongoing reference management.
  • Identify and address story and reference gaps across industries, buyer personas, use cases, products, geographies, and sales segments.
  • Recommend strategies to strengthen customer proof coverage in priority growth areas.

Create and Activate Exceptional Customer Stories

  • Lead customer discovery sessions, interviews, and narrative development efforts.
  • Help customers articulate their business challenges, implementation journeys, measurable outcomes, and future vision.
  • Translate complex platform, AI, automation, workflow, integration, data, and cloud capabilities into technically credible and commercially compelling stories.
  • Create and oversee a variety of customer assets, including:
    • Case studies
    • Customer videos
    • Executive interviews
    • Sales presentations
    • One-pagers
    • Testimonials
    • Keynote content
    • Award submissions
  • Collaborate with Brand, Product Marketing, Communications, and Field teams to activate stories across:
    • Marketing campaigns
    • Product launches
    • Digital experiences
    • Sales plays
    • Industry events
    • Public relations initiatives
    • Social media programs
    • Executive communications

Support Sales and Customer Advocacy

  • Build and maintain a portfolio of referenceable customers in partnership with Sales, Account Management, and Revenue Operations teams.
  • Manage customer reference requests by identifying appropriate advocates and ensuring a positive experience for both customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop sales-ready customer proof points, making it easy for account teams to access relevant stories, metrics, quotes, and peer examples.
  • Prepare customer advocates for:
    • Webinars
    • Industry events
    • Executive briefings
    • Prospect conversations
    • Analyst engagements
    • Media opportunities
    • Other strategic customer-facing activities

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in Customer Marketing, Customer Advocacy, Content Strategy, Product Marketing, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing customer stories for B2B SaaS, enterprise software, AI, automation, cloud, workflow, data, or technical platform solutions.
  • Proven ability to create compelling customer-facing content that drives engagement and business impact.
  • Experience working directly with senior customer stakeholders and executive audiences.

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional interviewing, writing, editing, and storytelling skills.
  • Strong portfolio of customer success stories, case studies, executive content, videos, or integrated campaigns.
  • Ability to uncover, quantify, and communicate customer business outcomes while maintaining technical accuracy and credibility.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Brand, PR, Legal, and Executive Leadership teams.
  • Excellent program and project management skills, including stakeholder coordination, editorial planning, approvals management, production timelines, and content operations.
  • Sound judgment regarding customer confidentiality, consent management, legal review processes, and responsible use of customer data and claims.

Why Join Siemens?

This is an opportunity to shape how Siemens tells its most important customer success stories and to build a world-class customer advocacy program that influences brand perception, pipeline growth, sales success, and customer loyalty. You will work across marketing, sales, and executive leadership teams to bring the voice of the customer to life at scale.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Siemens is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Salary Transparency Statement

The pay range for this position is $102,500 - $184,500 USD annually. The actual compensation offered will depend on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and business considerations.

In addition to base salary, Siemens offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include performance-based incentives, healthcare coverage, retirement savings programs, paid time off, and other employee benefits. Eligibility for specific programs may vary based on employment status and location.

Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands.

With over $1B+ in cumulative revenue, 12M+ customers, and 500+ talents across 19 countries, we combine technology, growth marketing, and operational excellence to scale purpose-driven, digitally native brands.

We own and operate our own digitally native brands (not an agency), with presence in Walmart, Nordstrom, and Amazon, and a strong global D2C footprint.

Why Trafilea

We’re a tech-led eCommerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast.

🚀 We build and scale our own brands.

🦾 We invest in AI and automation like few others in eCom.

📈 We test fast, grow fast, and help you do the same.

🤝 Be part of a dynamic, diverse, and talented global team.

🌍 100% Remote, USD competitive salary, paid time off, and more.

You’ll work directly with senior leaders, influence hiring decisions at the highest level, and build the talent pipelines that power our next stage of growth.

  • Own and manage the end-to-end recruitment process for marketing roles, ensuring a seamless, efficient, and high-quality experience from job opening to offer stage, following defined Talent Acquisition standards.

  • Conduct company and market mapping to identify top talent, and prepare clear, structured candidate presentations and documentation for the CMO and key stakeholders.

  • Leverage and manage ATS (Recruitee) and sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, and AI sourcing tools to drive effective candidate sourcing while maintaining accurate and organized pipelines.

  • Partner closely with Hiring Managers through regular syncs to align on role requirements, hiring strategies, and priorities—especially for critical and high-impact positions.

  • Create compelling, high-quality job postings that accurately reflect role expectations, team needs, and company culture to attract the right candidates.

  • Track and optimize recruitment performance using data, KPIs, and analytics

  • Turn into the team lead (3 to 5 people) and be the go-to person for all team members and PBPs.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in executing end-to-end talent acquisition processes (not just sourcing), particularly for marketing roles in fast-paced environments.

  • Strong understanding of marketing roles, specifically in areas such as digital marketing, growth, acquisition, and creative strategy.

  • Ability to analyze data and market trends to inform sourcing and recruitment strategies, maintaining accurate and actionable documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to critically assess candidates’ cultural fit and alignment with the company’s values.

  • Demonstrated ability to strictly follow established processes, with exceptional organizational skills to manage high volumes of information, documentation, and reporting requirements.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, fluent in both English and Spanish, with an ability to engage with candidates and hiring managers effectively.

As the Director, HR Technology Portfolio & Program Management, you will lead portfolio governance and program management across Hilton's global HR Technology organization. You will establish the operating disciplines, governance, and insights needed to effectively plan, prioritize, and deliver a complex portfolio of HR technology initiatives.

  • Lead integrated portfolio planning across HR Technology, maintaining visibility into initiatives, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, and delivery commitments.

  • Provide program management leadership for major cross-functional HR Technology initiatives, coordinating workstreams, milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, and implementation readiness.

  • Lead resource and capacity planning across the portfolio, partnering with internal teams and external partners to align demand, capacity, and delivery commitments.

  • Coordinate execution across HR Technology, HR Centers of Excellence, Enterprise Technology, regional teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
  • Partner with product and business leaders to establish program success measures and track delivery against intended business and operational outcomes.
  • Establish program management and governance practices for AI-enabled HR Technology initiatives, including readiness, dependencies, adoption, risk, and outcome tracking.
  • Modernize portfolio and program management practices through AI, automation, analytics, and modern tooling to improve planning, reporting, risk identification, and organizational productivity.

raw.title: KIP Spring 2027 - Economic Research Intern - Fulcrum Foundation

raw.description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

Overview

The Fulcrum Foundation seeks an intern to support research on state government regulatory policy and its effects on economic growth, entrepreneurship, labor markets, housing, occupational licensing, permitting, and related public policy issues.

Interns will work closely with senior researchers to gather and organize data, review proposed rules and administrative records, assist with research for public comment letters submitted to state agencies and legislatures, and contribute to policy briefs and reports intended for policymakers and the broader public.

The internship is designed for undergraduate students, recent graduates, and early-stage graduate or law students interested in public policy, economics, law, or government. Prior research experience is helpful but not required; we are looking for careful, curious people who write well and can work independently in a remote setting.

Research Areas

Potential areas of work include:

  • Administrative law, rulemaking, and the public comment process
  • Occupational licensing
  • Business permitting and approvals
  • Housing and land-use regulation
  • Small business and entrepreneurship policy
  • State economic development
  • Regulatory impact analysis
  • Government modernization and process reform
  • Labor market regulation
  • Institutional determinants of economic growth

Responsibilities

  • Assist with research for public comment letters on proposed state rules and regulations, including reviewing rulemaking notices, summarizing proposed rule text and agency justifications, and identifying relevant statutes, prior comments, and existing research.
  • Help draft and fact-check sections of comment letters, and compile supporting evidence, citations, and data appendices under the direction of senior staff.
  • Track state regulatory proposals, legislative activity, and agency actions relevant to Fulcrum’s research agenda.
  • Collect, organize, and document data from government websites, administrative records, and other publicly available sources.
  • Help maintain measures of regulatory burden, permitting processes, occupational licensing requirements, and related policy variables.
  • Conduct literature reviews and summarize academic and policy research for ongoing projects.
  • Draft sections of policy briefs, research summaries, and other written products, and assist with editing and citation.
  • Assist with basic descriptive analysis, tables, and charts using spreadsheet or statistical software.
  • Participate in research team meetings and contribute to project planning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Current undergraduate, graduate, or law student, or recent graduate, in economics, public policy, political science, law, public administration, or a related field.
  • Strong writing skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to read and accurately summarize dense material such as proposed rules, statutes, and academic research.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote environment.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States for the duration of the program, and able to attend all required KIP programming, including the two-day summit in Arlington, Virginia.

Preferred:

  • Coursework in economics, statistics, public policy, or administrative law.
  • Familiarity with R, Stata, Python, or another statistical program (not required).
  • Prior research experience through coursework, a research assistant position, or an internship.
  • Interest in state government policy, regulatory institutions, and economic development.
Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

raw.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritise candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the Role

As an HR Associate - Partner EOR, you will play a critical role in ensuring seamless HR generalist and operational support for clients and their employees utilising the Rippling Employer of Record services.

You will manage key processes such as onboarding, payroll data management, employee changes, and terminations by working closely with internal teams and external stakeholders. This role is highly detail-oriented, requiring strong organizational skills to handle data transfers and ensure compliance with regional regulations.

In addition to handling inquiries from the ticketing system, you will take ownership of operational tasks, including downloading, uploading, and transferring employee data across systems. You’ll act as a liaison between Ripplings partners, clients, employees, and internal teams to coordinate processes and provide efficient, accurate support across regions.

What you will do

  • Operational Support
    • Manage the onboarding process for new hires, including collecting required information from clients, completing intake forms, and preparing employment agreements in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
    • Facilitate employee onboarding by coordinating documentation, approvals, and secure data transfers between systems.
    • Ensure accurate and secure transfer of employee information between internal systems and external platforms, including uploading, updating, and synchronizing data.
    • Assist with payroll processes when required by preparing, uploading, and verifying data templates for payroll instructions and expenses, ensuring timely and accurate processing.
    • Handle ongoing employee changes, such as salary adjustments or role updates, by coordinating the preparation, review, and execution of necessary addendums and documentation.
    • Support the termination process by coordinating the collection of required information, and ensuring timely communication and execution of tasks.
  • Ticketing & Client Support
    • Serve as the first point of contact for HR inquiries, providing professional and timely first-line support for routine questions related to leave policies, performance management, HRIS navigation, and employee data updates.
    • Own the ticketing system, maintaining the queue and ensuring all inquiries receive prompt initial responses and are resolved within established KPIs for response and resolution times.
  • Documentation & Data Management
    • Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, and SOPs to standardize operations and enhance efficiency.
    • Ensure employment agreements, employee documentation, and other key records are accurately prepared, reviewed, and securely stored.
    • Prepare detailed metrics and reporting on task completion, ticket resolution, and process performance to support continuous improvement.
  • Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Collaborate closely with Regional Managers, Partner Managers, and internal teams to resolve escalations, coordinate multi-step processes, and ensure smooth operations.
    • Monitor and track progress on assigned tasks, ensuring deadlines are met and stakeholders are informed of updates.
    • Research and provide guidance on HR matters across multiple countries, ensuring compliance with local regulations and industry best practices.
  • Operational Efficiency
    • Create templates and macros for consistent responses and streamlined processes.
    • Maintain a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in all operational tasks, ensuring data integrity and compliance with relevant regulations.

What you will need

  • 3+ years of experience in HR support, operations, or a related role within a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes, including onboarding, payroll, employee changes, and terminations.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms and data management, including transferring and reconciling data across systems.
  • High attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks with competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively liaise with clients, employees, and internal teams.
  • Proficiency with ticketing systems (e.g., Salesforce) and HRIS platforms (e.g., Rippling, Workday).
  • Experience working in a global business and working with stakeholders in other countries is a plus
  • Professional working proficiency in English; additional language skills are a plus.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. Who we are:
Through a partnership-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. With an innovative quoting platform that delivers accurate pricing and bindable quotes in less than one minute, Coterie makes small business insurance effortless.

We are on a mission to build and foster a world-class team to bring speed, simplicity, and service to commercial insurance. We value integrity, humility, passion, and intelligence. If you want to push yourself and reshape a $200B+ market, we’re excited to talk to you!

Position Summary:
The Director, Partner Distribution is responsible for leading the performance, growth, and execution of Coterie’s partner distribution organization across high-potential and developing partner accounts. This leader will oversee Partner Account Executives and Partner Development Managers while driving strategic initiatives that increase partner production, activation, engagement, and profitable growth.

This role is responsible for establishing scalable frameworks for partner growth, account segmentation, performance management, and partner engagement strategies across traditional distribution channels.

The Director, Partner Distribution will collaborate closely with Insurance, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Partner Success teams to improve partner outcomes, strengthen relationships, and scale Coterie’s distribution footprint.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Partner Account Executives and Partner Development Managers.
  • Develop and execute growth strategies across strategic, emerging, and developing partner segments.
  • Drive partner production growth, activation, and engagement across assigned distribution channels.
  • Establish performance expectations, accountability frameworks, and operating cadences for the distribution team.
  • Monitor partner performance metrics including premium growth, submission activity, activation, engagement, and retention. • Collaborate with Revenue Operations to support forecasting, account segmentation, territory alignment, and reporting.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, Insurance, and Revenue Operations teams to support partner growth initiatives and enablement strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve partner lifecycle management and distribution scalability.
  • Support strategic partner initiatives and executive relationship management activities.
  • Develop processes and programs that improve partner activation, expansion, and long-term growth.
  • Represent Coterie at industry conferences, partner events, and distribution forums as needed.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and proactive relationship management.

Required Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Insurance, Marketing, or related field required.
  • 7+ years of experience in insurance distribution, partner management, sales leadership, or agency development.
  • Proven success leading revenue-generating teams and driving partner growth initiatives.
  • Experience managing agency, broker, embedded, or hybrid distribution relationships preferred.
  • Experience developing scalable distribution and engagement strategies.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong leadership and team development capabilities.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong strategic planning and operational execution abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and identify growth opportunities.
  • Extensive knowledge of Property & Casualty insurance distribution and agency operations.
  • Strong collaboration and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Problem solving mindset.

Our interview process:

Our hiring process generally consists of 3 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well!

  • Phase 1: Qualified candidates will first meet with a member of our People Operations team for a phone interview. This discussion is a high-level conversation to understand more about your background and interests and for us to share more about Coterie and the position.
  • Phase 2: Selected candidates will be invited to meet with our Hiring Manager for a 2nd interview via Teams video. This interview is designed to be more detail oriented and allows you to learn more about the role
  • Phase 3: Top candidates will receive an invite for our final interview series via Teams video. This series will include an experiential exercise project (provided in advance), 1:1 interviews with selected team members. The final series is roughly 1.5-3 hours in total but can be scheduled over a few days for flexibility.

What's in it for you:

Coterie has excellent benefits for all full-time employees. We offer the following:

  • 100% remote
  • Health insurance through Aetna (we pay 100% of premiums)
  • Dental and vision insurance through Guardian (we pay 100% of premiums)
  • Basic life insurance (we pay 100% of premiums)
  • Access to flexible spending account (FSA) or health savings account (HSA) (for those using HSA eligible plans)
  • 401K plan (up 4% match with immediate vest). Must be 21 years of age or older to participate
  • Flexible PTO is expected to align with business needs and generally does not exceed approximately 5 weeks per calendar year.
  • 12 company-paid holidays each year
  • Continuing education annual stipend
  • Annual salary estimated between 130,000-180,000 + Variable Compensation. Candidates who meet all the minimum requirements and possess additional relevant experience, as outlined in the job description, may be considered for a salary above the midpoint of the above range. Salary is based on internal equity; internal salary ranges; market data/ranges; applicant’s skills; prior relevant experience; degrees or certifications, etc.

Work Authorization:
At this time, Coterie Insurance is unable to consider candidates who require current or future visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future. Falsification of an application, including work authorization status, is immediate grounds for dismissal from consideration.

Job Title: Full-Stack Data Engineer

Job Location: Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

We are looking for a passionate Full Stack Data Engineer who will help strengthen our data engineering capability with modern software engineering practices. This individual will build robust, maintainable, and scalable data solutions across the data lifecycle, while also contributing to the team’s wider engineering standards, tooling, and ways of working.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is equally comfortable developing data pipelines, Python services, and automation for deployment and operations, and who can partner effectively with architects, analysts, product teams, and other engineers to deliver reliable data products.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and support scalable data pipelines, data products, and data applications that serve business and analytics needs.

  • Apply software engineering best practices to data engineering, including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, and maintainable architecture.

  • Develop Python-based solutions for data processing, orchestration, integration, automation, and supporting application components where required.

  • Own and improve DevOps/DataOps practices for data solutions, including CI/CD, environment promotion, release automation, observability, incident response, and production support.

  • Deliver robust, cost-effective, and automated solutions to address recurring business questions and analytical demands.

  • Design and implement data solutions aligned with enterprise standards, architecture roadmaps, and platform best practices, working closely with Data Architects and Solution Architects.

  • Test and quality assure data and analytics solutions to ensure they are fit for release, including code assurance, unit testing, integration testing, data validation, performance tuning, and release management.

  • Support operational excellence through proactive monitoring, root-cause analysis, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of SLAs and service reliability.

  • Promote engineering consistency across the team by disseminating best practices, coaching peers, contributing reusable patterns, and helping improve standards, tooling, and ways of working.

  • Evaluate and adopt new technologies relevant to data engineering, software engineering, and platform automation, including proof-of-value assessments and contribution to business cases.

  • Contribute to estimates, delivery planning, and solution design for new data initiatives and enhancements.

  • Ensure business data assets are delivered as trusted, discoverable, and reusable data products/services for broader enterprise consumption, in alignment with strategic data principles.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions, define acceptance criteria, and establish appropriate operational and service expectations.

  • Maintain ongoing professional development in modern data, cloud, and engineering practices to help keep AstraZeneca current with a changing technology landscape.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience building production-grade solutions using sound engineering principles such as modular design, testing, code review, and maintainability.

  • Strong Python engineering skills, including building reusable packages, APIs, automation scripts, data processing components, and integration services.

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating solutions in Snowflake, including virtual warehouse configuration, resource monitors, governance, and performance tuning.

  • Expert SQL for analytics and transformation, with strong skills in query optimization, pruning, caching behavior, and result set reuse.

  • Experience building robust pipelines into Snowflake with tools such as dbt, Airflow, dataops.live, Fivetran, AWS Glue, or AWS Lambda, with strong understanding of staging patterns, incremental loads, CDC, retries, error handling, and observability.

  • Practical experience with data modeling, including dimensional and normalized approaches, and strong understanding of schema design, standardization, clustering keys, micro-partitioning, and workload/performance strategies.

  • Experience with dbt modeling layers, materializations, testing, project configuration, documentation standards, and data contracts.

  • Experience implementing automated testing and quality controls for data solutions, including unit, integration, and data validation testing.

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and deployment automation for data and application components.

  • Experience with DevOps/DataOps practices, including environment management, release management, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and production support.

  • Experience integrating Python-based data engineering solutions with serverless and cloud-native services, such as AWS Lambda and AWS Glue.

  • Demonstrated track record delivering solutions on modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Redshift, and integrating them with downstream analytics or visualization tools.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including diagnosing and resolving production issues in complex data environments.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions and data products with clear ownership, SLAs, and acceptance criteria.

  • Strong understanding of FAIR data principles and data product best practices, including discoverability, metadata, lineage, interoperability, access controls, versioning, and consumer-oriented design.

  • Effective working independently and within cross-functional, cross-cultural teams, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Demonstrable passion for learning and for improving engineering practices across a team.

Desired Skills

  • Experience using Starburst/Trino for distributed SQL across heterogeneous data sources.

  • Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and highly automated platform or pipeline delivery patterns.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code and environment provisioning in cloud-based data platforms.

  • Familiarity with metadata and catalog tooling such as Collibra to improve lineage, standards adoption, reuse, and observability.

  • Experience using PySpark for large-scale data processing and transformation in distributed environments.

  • Experience building lightweight application or service layers that complement data pipelines, such as APIs, internal tools, or operational utilities.

  • Experience mentoring peers and helping establish engineering standards across a team or community of practice.

Summary

The Full Stack Data Engineer is responsible for the design, development, deployment, and operational support of scalable data products and data applications in a DevOps/DataOps delivery model. This role combines strong data engineering expertise with a solid software engineering background, especially in Python, cloud-native development, and engineering automation.

The role is expected not only to build reliable data solutions, but also to raise engineering maturity across the team by disseminating best practices in software design, testing, CI/CD, observability, reuse, and operational excellence.

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. Job Title: Vice President, Market Access, HEOR and Patient Services - Radiopharma

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

Our business purpose: We are a purpose-driven team working to drive life-changing clarity in precision diagnostics that helps uncover what’s hidden inside the body – enabling earlier, more confident decisions in the fight against diseases like Alzheimer's, cardiovascular conditions, and cancer. As part of a company that delivers both radiopharmaceutical doses and the PET imaging infrastructure needed to use them, we play a critical role in expanding access to precision diagnostics – for providers, for systems, and most importantly, for patients. What sets us apart is a combination of unmatched clinical expertise, unwavering commitment to advancing science, as well as our deep commitment to showing up with urgency, care, and empathy – helping more people move from uncertainty to understanding. We believe that behind every scan is a heartbeat and behind every heartbeat is a story, and we treat each one like it matters – because lives are shaped in moments like these.

Who thrives here: You’ll thrive here if you care deeply – about your teammates, about the people we serve, and about doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. You bring both heart and discipline to your work, with a curiosity to uncover what customers truly need and the courage to make tough calls when clarity is elusive. This is a space where ambiguity is real, decisions carry weight, and collaboration isn’t optional – it’s how we move forward. If you find meaning in building something that matters and supporting others while doing it, you’ll feel at home here.

GE HealthCare’s US Radiopharma business is seeking Executive, Market Access, HEOR and Patient services to lead the market access strategy for a growing portfolio of molecular imagine and radiopharmaceutical products across cardiology, neurology and oncology.

Job Description

This role will be responsible for leading US market access strategies across payer access, reimbursement policy, CMS and Medicaid strategy, HEOR, coverage/payment pull through, field reimbursement, patient services and provider-facing access support. This leader will play a critical role in shaping how providers, patients and health systems gain access to our products, including influencing the broader reimbursement, coverage and policy environment to support long-term RP growth.

The ideal candidate will bring strong market access leadership in complex, specialty healthcare markets, including deep understanding of reimbursement, provider economics, government payer dynamics and access execution in the field. This individual should be equally comfortable shaping strategy at the leadership level and overseeing practical execution across the market access verticals.

This is a highly visible leadership role at GE HealthCare and will partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial Operations leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create and lead the US market access strategy for RP portfolio aligned to business priorities, growth objectives and future launches
  • Develop and execute strategies across commercial and government payer access, reimbursement policy, providers reimbursement, and access pull-through
  • Lead planning related to Medicare, Medicaid, CMS, and reimbursement policy, including assessment of coding, coverage and payment dynamics impacting the entire portfolio
  • Define and lead the HEOR and value evidence strategy in support of payer engagement, provider economics and broader market adoption
  • Oversee development of access related tools and programs including economic models, value communication assets, and evidence-based support for payer and provider discussions
  • Lead field reimbursement and patient service strategy, including education, escalation support, service model, and access-related operational support
  • Partner closely and compliantly with commercial teams to ensure access strategy supports customer onboarding, reimbursement readiness and utilization growth
  • Provide strategic guidance on provider economics and practical reimbursement barriers across hospitals, FSICs, physician practices and other target sites of care
  • Lead external market access and policy engagement strategies that help shape reimbursement and coverage environment for the entire GE HealthCare portfolio, including other segments, new product launches and acquisition product lines
  • Identify, develop and support opportunities to influence coverage frameworks, reimbursement policies
  • Help shape the evidence, health economic, and value narrative needed to support broader clinical acceptance, guidelines evolution and favorable healthcare coverage decisions
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle management with accountability for market access SME and workstreams
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing team and scalable operating model to support a rapidly growing business

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree in business management, public health, healthcare administration preferred
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in market access, reimbursement, HEOR, health policy, payer strategy and patient services
  • Significant experience in specialty pharma, Radiopharma, molecular imaging, oncology, specialty biopharma or other complex provider-administered healthcare segments
  • Demonstrated expertise in US reimbursement an access, including Medicare/CMS and government payer strategy
  • Experience leading or shaping field reimbursement, provider support, and patient service capabilities
  • Experience leading and shaping external policy, reimbursement trends, guidelines and stakeholder engagement that influence access and coverage
  • Proven ability to lead large teams, influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Experience launching new products or categories
  • Experience supporting buy and bill, outpatient and imaging center site of care
  • Strong knowledge of HEOR and real-world evidence strategies for access strategies
  • Experience engaging with provider organizations, professional societies, policy stakeholders to support favorable market access conditions
We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $240,000.00-$360,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

Additional Information

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

Job Description:

Join General Dynamics IT and be a part of a team that solve some of the world's most complex technical challenges. We are seeking a 5GNetwork Integration Lead to join our team in support of the Army TEN-M program.


This is a remote position and requires 25% to 50% travel; you must reside within a 50-mile radius of a major airport


As the Network Integration Lead, you:


  • Oversee the activation of newly deployed fiber routes and their integration into the existing optical transport network.
  • Configure and integrates 5G Core network functions, transport systems, and IP network infrastructure.
  • Manage DWDM and ROADM configuration, optical power alignment, transponder turn up, and end to end lightpath provisioning.
  • Coordinate closely with construction, OSP, QA/QC, and NOC teams to ensure the fiber plant is validated, optical equipment is correctly tuned, and all services are brought online with proper documentation and minimal service impact.
  • Validate interfaces between network components and Government systems, performs system acceptance testing, executes troubleshooting activities, captures logs and packet traces, and supports optimization and closeout activities.
  • Develop integration procedures, validates interoperability between vendor platforms, and ensures compliance with customer security and operational requirements.

Basic Qualifications:


  • BS/BA Degree; additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree
  • 15+ years of network configuration management experience with emphasis on 5G technologies and understanding of the duties as described above
  • 5+ years of technical leadership experience
  • Secret Clearance

  • 401K with company match
  • Educational Assistance and eLearning
  • Flexible work week
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to employee advancement

  • Innovative and collaborative environment encouraging of highly motivated critical thinking

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud.
